title:
This epic listens to `FORM_SUBMIT` action on `Reliability.SelectGlobalFacilitiesModalForm` and does the following:

1. Updates {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#selectedFacilities} to the list of Ids that are currently selected in the UI.
2. Updates `title` and `subtitle` of `Reliability.GlobalFacilityFilterTopContent`.
3. Closes the `Reliability.SelectGlobalFacilitiesModal`
name: UpdateSelectedFacilitiesEpic
